تستعملوا (form X)
# تَسْتَعْمِلُوا (tastaʕmilū) /tas.taʕ.mi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْمَلَ (istaʕmala)
# تُسْتَعْمَلُوا (tustaʕmalū) /tus.taʕ.ma.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْمَلَ (istaʕmala)
